parsed.summary: The change adds support for item_comments in the syndication framework, but it is not clear if it handles all edge cases or if it breaks existing behavior.

issues.description: The change does not address how item_comments should be handled if they are not provided or if they are invalid. This could lead to functional incompleteness.

The change introduces a new attribute (comments) to the feed items, which could potentially break existing code that relies on the current feed item structure. This introduces a risk of behavioral regression.
